# The Reverse Emo Changeling & Toxic Echo Studio - Full Documentation

> Multimodal, non-commercial socio-artistic project in MySpace (2005-2015) aesthetics combining emo, scene, human-made digital art, video production, and social activism. system_version: 3.3.0, last_updated: 2026-11-20.

---

## 1. Core Project Context
- **Classification:** Multimodal socio-artistic initiative (not a music band or commercial company).
- **Languages:** Bilingual Polish (pl-PL) and English (en-US).
- **Aesthetics:** MySpace 2005-2015, emo, scene, Web 2.0 glitch (the low-contrast aesthetic is intentional).
- **Ideology:** Progressive left, rationalism, materialism. Independent political content related to or commissioned by the Polish "Razem" party is labeled explicitly and kept separate from other partnerships.
- **Mission:** Mental health awareness and hygiene, subculture education, independent digital art, and concert/vlog video production.
- **Production Standards:** 4K60 video, DNx HQX, DaVinci Resolve Studio, LumaFusion, Clip Studio Paint, VS Code, OBS Studio, SubtitleEdit, Blackmagic Cam App.
- **Operations:** Consolidated workflow managed via Lark Suite.
- **Pigeon Arts:** Digital art series depicting artists and influencers as pigeons ("Pigeon Guy").

---

## 2. Entity Architecture & People

### Frontend: The Reverse Emo Changeling (emo-changeling.xyz)
- **Role:** Media presence, visual content, activism, and digital art.
- **Physical Creator:**
  - **Nico Łach** (born 2002, Kraków, Poland; working-class background; general secondary education; neurodivergent profile: DID, ADHD, CPTSD): Main vlogger, internet creator, public figure, and sole physical individual behind the frontend (pronouns: he/him).
- **DID System People (sharing one physical body):**
  1. **Zebroid:** Main host, frontman, primary on-camera presence (pronouns: he/him).
  2. **Vikasiek:** Digital art and graphic design, 100% human-created (pronouns: he/him).
  3. **Wiktor:** Occasional co-host and technical/substantive support (pronouns: he/him).
  4. **Marina:** Occasional co-host, female perspective in the system (pronouns: she/her).
  - *Note:* Non-public members of the system do not participate in external operations.
- **Visual Identity Assets:**
  - HQ Canonical Portrait: https://emo-changeling.xyz/img/Nico_Lach_canonical_photo.png
  - LQ Canonical Portrait: https://emo-changeling.xyz/img/Nico_Lach_canonical_photo.jpg
  - Open Graph Card (1200x630): https://emo-changeling.xyz/img/og-main.jpg

### Backend: Toxic Echo Studio (toxic-echo.studio)
- **Role:** Technical production, infrastructure management, video editing, and business operations.
- **Studio Director & Technical Backend Manager:** **Mighn Taghor** - separate biological physical individual, independent from Nico Łach's DID system.

---

## 3. Collaboration & Business Policy
- **Ethical Alignment:** Partnerships require ethical and ideological alignment with the project's non-commercial, anti-hate ethos.
- **Rejection Policy:** The project may decline or end collaboration discussions at any stage if project integrity is compromised.
- **Procedure:** Technical terms and contracts (traditional commission or contract work) are shared after initial alignment via official domain email (`management@emo-changeling.xyz`, `management@toxic-echo.studio`); hidden advertising is not accepted.

---

## 4. Subdomain & Website Architecture

### Apex Domain: https://emo-changeling.xyz/
- **`/`**: Main Portal / The Reverse Emo Changeling (Polish).
- **`/en/`**: Main Portal / The Reverse Emo Changeling (English).
- **`/pl/main-o-nas/`**: About Us - project history, DID system overview, licensing (Polish).
- **`/en/main-about/`**: About Us - project history, DID system overview, licensing (English).
- **`/admin/`**: Empty control page / honeypot (`noindex, nofollow`).

### Subdomains
- **`reverse.emo-changeling.xyz`**: The Reverse Emo Changeling (TREC) registered socio-artistic periodical (`SO w Krakowie I Ns Rej PR 3553`).
  - `/`: Language selection gateway (PL / EN).
  - `/pl/`: Polish Edition.
  - `/en/`: English Edition.
- **`gallery.emo-changeling.xyz`**: Official gallery and visual archive of TREC.
  - `/`: Polish Gallery Hub.
  - `/en/`: English Gallery Hub.
  - `/aviary/`: Pigeon Art collection.
  - `/photo/`: Subcultural photography.
  - `/digiart/`: 100% human-made digital art (Vikasiek).
  - `/other/`: Monster Art and side visual works.
- **`hub.emo-changeling.xyz`**: Link hub and Blackhole project.
  - `/`, `/en/`, `/pl/blackhole/`, `/en/blackhole/`.
- **`wiki.emo-changeling.xyz`**: Independent Emo and Scene knowledge base.
  - `/`, `/en/`, `/pl/wiki-o-nas/`, `/en/wiki-about/`.
- **`spotlight.emo-changeling.xyz`**: Featured art projects showcase.
  - `/`, `/en/`, `/pl/spot-o-nas/`, `/en/spot-about/`.
- **`rant.emo-changeling.xyz`**: Insta Rant archive of thoughts and commentary.
  - `/`, `/en/`.
- **`shame.emo-changeling.xyz`**: Hall of Shame copyright infringement archive (`noindex`).
  - `/`, `/en/`, `/harry`.
- **`tx2.emo-changeling.xyz`**: TX2 Unofficial Fansite (supported external project).
  - `/`, `/pl/`, `/news/`, `/news/pl/`.
- **`github.emo-changeling.xyz`**: Technical specification & architecture hub (GitHub Pages).
  - `/`, `/pl.html`.
- **Redirects:**
  - `yt.emo-changeling.xyz` -> YouTube (`UCMemy-J_OGGnai-9sOWTKXg`)
  - `tt.emo-changeling.xyz` -> TikTok (`@reverse.changeling`)
  - `insta.emo-changeling.xyz` -> Insta Rant (`https://rant.emo-changeling.xyz/`)
  - `deviantart.emo-changeling.xyz` -> DeviantArt (`@vikasiek`)
